seoTitle: CPM, CPC and CPA Calculator: Solve for Any Missing Value
metaDescription: Enter any two of spend, units and rate for CPM, CPC or CPA, and the third is solved. Free and private, runs in your browser.
intro: Fill two of the three values in a group and the calculator solves for the third.
why:
Ad costs are three related numbers: spend, units and cost per unit. Often you know two and need the third, for example how many clicks a budget buys at a given CPC.

Leave a field empty to mark it unknown. CTR and click-to-conversion rates are shown when the numbers are present. CPM is cost per 1000 impressions.
howTo: In each group fill the units or the rate, leaving the one you want empty.
Check for the agreement warning when all three are filled.

faq.a: Yes, leave spend empty and fill units and rate.

faq.q: Why is only one group solved?
faq.a: Each group needs two known values.
